_comment: Cambridge English Exam Prep — Full Assignment JSON Import Template (All 10 Question Types + Optional Question Images). Give this exact schema to an LLM and ask it to return a single valid JSON object.
title: B2 Complete Showcase: Sustainable Cities
instructions: Read the passage on the left and complete each question type on the right.
media_content:
Paragraph A: Across Europe, city planners are rethinking how urban neighbourhoods balance public transport, green spaces, and affordable housing. [1]

Paragraph B: Residents who live within a ten-minute walk of public parks report lower stress levels and stronger community ties. [2]

questions.prompt: According to Paragraph B, what benefit is associated with living near public parks?
options: Lower stress levels and stronger community ties
questions.correct_answer: Lower stress levels and stronger community ties
questions.explanation: Paragraph B explicitly mentions lower stress levels and stronger community ties.

questions.prompt: European city planners have completely banned private cars from all residential areas.
questions.explanation: The passage mentions balancing public transport and housing, but does not state whether cars are banned.

questions.prompt: Urban planners must make a careful ________ between green space and housing density.
questions.explanation: Noun form of 'decide' is 'decision' (collocation: make a decision).

questions.prompt: Match each statement or synonym to the correct paragraph (or definition).

pairs.prompt: Mentions how cities balance transport and housing
Refers to mental wellbeing benefits of nearby parks

questions.explanation: Paragraph A discusses transport and housing; Paragraph B discusses stress levels.

questions.prompt: Choose which removed sentence (A–C) best fits each numbered gap [1] and [2] in the passage. There is one extra sentence you do not need.

passages.label: A
passages.text: In several capitals, old car parks are being converted into pocket gardens and cycling hubs.

passages.label: B
passages.text: Local councils have noticed that these green corridors also encourage children to play outdoors.

passages.label: C
passages.text: Meanwhile, deep-sea fishing quotas remained unchanged throughout the winter.

questions.explanation: Sentence A connects to transport/green spaces in Paragraph A; Sentence B extends the park benefits in Paragraph B; C is the distractor.

questions.prompt: Choose the best word from each dropdown to complete the text.

question_data.text: When the council {{1}} the new bike lane, commuters quickly {{2}} advantage of the safer route.

questions.explanation: 'Launch a bike lane' and 'take advantage of' are natural B2 collocations.

questions.prompt: Click words from the word bank to complete the sentences. One word is not needed.

question_data.text: The new metro station is {{1}} located near the university and {{2}} priced for students.

questions.explanation: 'Conveniently located' and 'reasonably priced' are standard adverb-adjective collocations.

questions.prompt: Put the segments in the correct order to form a C1-style inverted sentence.
questions.explanation: 'Not only + auxiliary + subject + verb ... but also ...' requires subject-auxiliary inversion.

questions.prompt: Correct the highlighted grammatical error in the sentence below.

question_data.sentence: She suggested me to take the earlier train to Cambridge.

questions.explanation: The verb 'suggest' is followed by -ing or 'that + subject + verb', never 'object + to-infinitive'.

questions.prompt: Which TWO advantages of urban parks are mentioned in the passage?
options: They lower stress levels among nearby residents
They eliminate the need for public buses

correct_answers: They lower stress levels among nearby residents

questions.explanation: Paragraph B highlights both lower stress levels and stronger community ties.

questions.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it has a similar meaning to the first sentence, using the word given. Do not change the word given. You must use between two and five words, including the word given.

question_data.original_sentence: I regret not booking the train tickets earlier.

questions.explanation: Use 'wish + past perfect' (wish I had booked) to express regret about a past action. Worth 2 points (1 pt per half).

questions.prompt: Sort each linking expression into Formal (suitable for C1 essays) or Informal (suitable for casual emails).
questions.explanation: 'Furthermore' and 'Nevertheless' belong to formal academic register; 'Anyway' and 'Loads of' are informal.

questions.prompt: Cambridge Speaking Part 2 Practice: Talk for 60 seconds comparing the advantages of living in a green city versus the countryside.
questions.explanation: Graded by your teacher on Pronunciation, Discourse Management, Lexical Resource, and Grammar.

questions.prompt: Write a short essay (140–190 words) discussing whether private cars should be restricted in historic city centres.
questions.explanation: Evaluated on Cambridge B2 criteria: Content, Communicative Achievement, Organisation, and Language.
